name: Bybit
description: Your Bybit balance and transactions as one USD account, from a read-only API key. Securo only accepts a read-only API key. It can see your balance and transactions but cannot trade or withdraw.

network.purpose: Bybit's API: checks the key is read-only, then reads the wallet and Earn balances, the Funding ledger, Bybit Card records and card points. Read endpoints only.

integrations.name: Bybit
integrations.description: Paste a read-only Bybit API key. Create it in Bybit under Profile → API → Create New Key, with Read-Only, and tick Wallet, Earn and Bybit Card. The first sync only links; press Sync now or wait for the next run.
